verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page says Rovo AI can 'identify trends to surface new opportunities and remove bottlenecks' from work data, and can break down ideas into tasks and suggest assignees, which covers in-product AI insights and suggestions. The evidence is only one-line marketing claims, and no community or hands-on item covers the AI features. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how Rovo insights are generated and shown, independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
